subject: 两层商铺·茶坊
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE realistic Southern Song Chinese Lin'an two-storey tea shop building sprite for an orthographic game town map, isolated true transparent RGBA. Most important is the EXACT geometry of a thin rectangular foundation slab in a 2:1 game projection: in a 1536 x 1536 square image, foundation polygon corners are LEFT (224,1050), FRONT (864,1370), RIGHT (1344,1130), BACK (704,810). The long visible front edge runs from LEFT to FRONT: 640px right, 320px down. The short side edge runs FRONT to RIGHT: 480px right, 240px up. Thus front-facing frontage is 8 units and depth is 6 units, NOT a square, NOT a symmetric diamond. All horizontal architecture shares these two exact parallel axes, slope +0.5 and -0.5. Orthographic yaw 45 elevation 30, NO vanishing point. Build the tea shop ON this exact rectangular footprint, preserve all four foundation edges where visible. Flat thin stone paved base, not a thick pedestal. Narrower 6-unit side wall faces lower-right; wide 8-unit shop facade faces lower-left. Two storeys of warm weathered timber, ivory plaster, restrained grey handmade clay roof tiles; delicate balcony, bamboo blinds, tea jars, wooden tables in open shopfront. Realistic hand-crafted historic game environment, detailed physical textures with warm muted earth colors; no stylized cartoon outlines. Camera level axes and vertical pillars, complete roof with generous transparent space around entire object. Upper-left sunlight and short lower-right contact shadow. No text, no signs or glyphs, no diagrams, no grid, no coordinates or lines, no people, no modern objects, no checkerboard texture, no horizon or backdrop, no glow. The polygon is a construction constraint, not a diagram to display.
negative: 文字、标牌字、水印、人物、天空、地平线、背景色、棋盘格、厚地台、大阴影、现代物、清代形制、透视消失点、裁切屋檐、卡通。
created_time_basis: 生成后记录的接收/归档时间；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 返修第2轮：已逐张view_image；底面宽深恢复，宋式灰瓦木构及商用/客栈陈设完整，无文字人物现代物，左上主光；底面接触角按可见地坪外缘读点并用alpha>=192轮廓复核。64×32网格叠图另存review2；细小轴向残差按geometry_qa如实登记，目视判断不等于严格几何通过。
